problem: Error-bar cap endpoints are picked up as extra data points, producing a dense pink scatter cloud in the re-plot that does not exist in the clean source curves.
suggested_fix: Detect and discard small marks that lie at error-bar whisker endpoints rather than at series vertices.

problem: The legend label reads '10 MAE = 0.828' because an axis tick value ('10') was merged into the annotation text.
suggested_fix: Exclude axis tick-label text from legend/annotation text spans when building the series label.

problem: Several overlapping colored curves bunched near the x-axis are collapsed into only two extracted series, so most series are missing.
suggested_fix: Improve color separation for tightly overlapping curves so each distinct-color series is recovered.

problem: Beyond the real smooth curves the re-plot is flooded with scattered blue/orange/brown noise points that do not lie on any actual curve.
suggested_fix: Add a density/continuity filter to drop isolated marker pixels that do not align with a recovered curve.

problem: The re-plot shows a doubled/broken y-axis and stray green points around 2.5-2.6 that are inconsistent with the single calibrated-sigma axis in the source.
suggested_fix: Use a single consistent y-calibration and drop the secondary-axis tick contamination producing the stray points.

problem: One series legend label is rendered as the bare marker glyph 'o' instead of its real name, leaving the dashed-reference series mislabeled.
suggested_fix: Fall back to the legend entry text when the marker glyph is mistaken for the label string.
